audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers agreed with each other but disagreed with the packet chart and with their own whys on five rows: levels 2-5 and the two-item row were handed to Vladimir while the whys say he has no gap-closer and you close the matchup out at two items.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [Ziggs, Ziggs, Ziggs, Ziggs, Ziggs, Vladimir, Ziggs], and the already-audited mirror set row 0 to Skill, rows 1-3 to Ziggs and row 4 to Skill. Mirroring that gives Skill, Ziggs, Ziggs, Ziggs, Skill, Vladimir, Ziggs.
audit.corrected: All disagreeing rows realigned in matched full/content pairs with ratings 5/6/6/6/5/4/7.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as a clean Ziggs spike with no mention of what Hemoplague does to the stage, and the two-item row was given to Vladimir against its own why.
audit.why: Hemoplague is a flat 120s at 625 range: it amplifies damage taken and heals Vladimir for each champion hit, so level 6 is even, not yours. Mega Inferno Bomb is 120/95/70s. His real spike is the first sustain item; yours is two items of range and waveclear.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why and phases[6].why rewritten to state Hemoplague's heal-per-champion and the two-item siege plan.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sanguine Pool was described only as an 'untargetable dodge' with a made-up 'fifteen-second' cooldown, and Transfusion's range and cooldown never appeared.
audit.why: Riot kit: Sanguine Pool is 28/25/22/19/16s at 350 range and grants 2 seconds of untargetability, so a wasted Pool at rank 1 is a 28s window, not 15. Transfusion is 600 range on 9/7.9/6.8/5.7/4.6s against your 850-range Q.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d now states the 2s untargetable window and the bait sequence; dosFull[2].d carries the real 28s; phases[0].why carries the 850-vs-600 range gap.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item spike told you to out-poke his sustain window without naming the item class that beats it.
audit.why: missingInteractions rule needs-antiheal: Vladimir sustains through chip damage with Transfusion (Q) and Hemoplague (R), so Grievous Wounds timing decides every extended trade.
audit.corrected: spikes[2].text now names Grievous Wounds and the two healing sources.

edits.before: Q bombs out-range every melee tool in the game — chunk Vladimir on every last-hit attempt, but respect early minion aggro.
edits.after: Your Q reaches 850 to his Transfusion's 600, but a 9s heal on a health-cost kit refills whatever you chip at level 1.

edits.before: Mega Inferno Bomb online — any chipped target or crashing wave is now your gold. Hold it for the sub-60% HP window.
edits.after: Mega Inferno Bomb (120s) online, but Hemoplague heals him per champion hit — Grievous Wounds before you spend it.

edits.before: Shadowflame + Torch makes the full rotation lethal, but the map matters more — rotate R to sieges and skirmishes.
edits.after: Two items and your range plus waveclear close it out — R sieges, minefields cover flanks against his Hemoplague dive.

edits.before: Vladimir's brutal early weakness lets you poke him for free at level 1.
edits.after: Transfusion (600 range, 9s) answers a level-1 step-up — trade even.

edits.before: At 6 his R is a damage amp, not an escape, so your poke still rules.
edits.after: At 6 Hemoplague amps damage and heals him for each champ hit.

edits.before: Untargetable dodge — bait it before you spend your kill window. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: Pool is 2s untargetable — bait it with a Q, then commit; your R and mines land only after it ends.

edits.before: Vladimir burns Sanguine Pool on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Sanguine Pool is 28s at rank 1 — a wasted Pool is your whole kill window.

edits.before: Vladimir's power spike is Rylai's/Riftmaker sustain — he heals through your poke and his Transfusion (Q) becomes spammable, so this is his window to out-sustain you; back off extended trades and poke in short bursts he can't fully heal.
edits.after: Vladimir's spike is sustain — Transfusion drops to 4.6s at rank 5 and Hemoplague heals him for every champion hit, so buy Grievous Wounds before this window; poke in short bursts he cannot fully heal and refuse the extended trades he wants.

notes: Rows 5 and 6 were not covered by the mirror's listed corrections; I took row 5 (Vladimir) and row 6 (Ziggs) from packet.levelChart, which both existing whys already agree with. I did not assert that Satchel Charge deals percent-max-health damage — the derived flag says so but Riot's W text describes plain magic damage plus a knock-away, and the mirror flagged the same contradiction.
